figures.caption: Table 3: Watermark Removal Detection. Detection rates at operating points FPR=10−2 and 10−3 (calibrated on COCO).
Table 1: Image quality metrics between original and variant images. PSNR (↑), LPIPS (↓), and FID (↓).

Figure 2: Detector robustness under post-processing. ROC curves (log-scale FPR) for four transform families at increasing strength. The detector maintains AUC > 0.988 under JPEG, blur, and resize. Gaussian noise is the best evasion strategy but requires levels visibly degrading the image.

Figure 1: Watermark removal attacks samples, with residuals and Fourier spectrum. WMForger and Diffpure have the smallest residual footprint by targeting the high frequencies, which is better depicted in Fourier Spectrum figures, while CtrlRegen and SANA-VAE are spreading on the whole image their removal effort.
